question: What is the knowability of an entity if it is not an intrinsic property of the entity?
premises: Knowability of an entity is identified with an arising of consciousness.
This arising takes the form of grasping an object.
Such object-grasping occurs within consciousness itself.
inference: An entity's knowability is nothing other than consciousness arising in the form of object-grasping.
plain_english: The knowability of an entity is just the arising of consciousness in the form of grasping an object. It happens within consciousness itself, not as a property sitting in the entity.
